about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Lead Software Engineer with a decade of experience spanning mobile development, full-stack blockchain, and high-throughput backend systems. I've shipped mobile apps, multi-chain Web3 platforms, and event-driven microservices trusted by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide.

Today I lead a team at John Deere, delivering the software that powers scanners, printers, and industrial machines across factories worldwide. Recognized as Employee of the Year and Best Team Lead at Reliance Jio (Fynd), I care deeply about reliability, clean architecture, and mentoring engineers to ship with confidence — bridging device-level engineering with the cloud.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.subheading: Where I have led teams and shipped systems that scale.

points: Lead a cross-functional team delivering the software that powers scanners, printers, and industrial machines across John Deere factories worldwide.
Drive Android engineering for on-machine device interfaces and factory-floor apps, improving operator throughput and reliability.
Own the architecture of full-stack platforms integrating IoT device telemetry, real-time monitoring, and cloud services across global sites.

Architected Frolic, a real-time fantasy platform, using event-driven microservices (Node.js, Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL) scaling to 200K+ concurrent users with automated contest creation, auto-cancellation, and prize distribution.
Expanded real-time Product Recommendations for the Search Extension, syncing 100K+ products and 100K+ user events per hour to Google Retail Cloud for Tira, Reliance Trends, Netmeds, and GoFynd.
Cut real-time matchmaking latency from 2s to 500ms with a high-performance Redis-backed WebSocket microservice, offloading polling from core servers and boosting user satisfaction by 30%.

Built a full-featured crypto marketplace (KraftNFT) with an order book, NFT minting, and auctions across Solana, Ethereum & Tron (ERC-721/1155) — $11K+ monthly revenue, 45K+ DAU, and 35–55ms API latency.
Designed multi-chain custodial and non-custodial wallet infrastructure (7K+ Q1 transactions) and enhanced a k6/xk6 load-testing platform with ClickHouse reporting and Grafana dashboards.

Led a scalable crypto exchange (Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka) with 150+ REST APIs and centralized wallet management across Bitcoin, Ethereum & Solana — supporting 8K+ concurrent trades and onboarding 72K+ global users.

Built a generic product-tracking system on Ethereum with dynamic smart contracts for real-time shipment and ownership tracking, integrated with DMCC — supporting 200K+ shipments and 50K+ smart contracts across 12+ categories.
Engineered a Smart Contract Audit & decentralized wallet extension across Ethereum, Polygon & BSC — leading 4+ developers, managing 10K+ active wallets and $16K+ monthly revenue.
Built Zeptagram, a decentralized music-rights platform (Node.js, React.js, MongoDB) with NFT (ERC-721) support, onboarding 90K+ creators.
Contributed to Centralex, a licensed hybrid CeFi + DeFi digital-asset exchange bridging centralized and decentralized finance into a single platform.
Shipped a real-time cricket-betting Android app (Java, XML) on the Sportsy platform, integrated with a high-performance backend supporting 80K+ active users.
Built MurMur, an Android short-form news aggregator that predated Inshorts and drew an incubation offer from Hindustan Times.
Developed an Android Bitcoin wallet app (Android Studio + Node.js) with secure key management for GainBitcoin.
Managed company-wide New Relic monitoring and query optimization — cutting average response time by 40% — and launched a promotions & discount engine that lifted average order value by 20%.

process.heading: How I Work With You
process.subheading: A transparent, customer-first engineering process — from the very first conversation to a product that scales. You stay in the loop at every single step.

steps.title: Discover & Understand
steps.description: We start by listening. I sit down with you to capture what you actually need — the goals, the users, the constraints — and understand the real problem behind the request.

steps.title: Analyze & Refine Requirements
steps.description: Together we pressure-test and refine the requirements, cut what doesn't serve the goal, and lock a clear scope. This is where we prevent wasted time, money, and resources.

steps.title: Architect for Scale
steps.description: As your engineer-architect I design the entire infrastructure — choosing the right stack and patterns so the system meets today's needs and scales cleanly as you grow.

steps.title: Build the MVP
steps.description: I ship a lean, working MVP fast — the smallest thing that delivers real value — so you can see it, use it, and validate the direction with real feedback.

steps.title: Iterate & Improve
steps.description: With your feedback we improve in short, focused cycles — hardening, refining, and adding what matters most, one release at a time.

steps.title: Support & Grow
steps.description: After launch I stay on — monitoring, maintaining, and scaling the platform as your business grows. You're never left on your own.

steps.title: Support Existing Systems
steps.description: Already have a system built? I step in to support, stabilize, and scale it — even code I didn't write. Bug fixes, performance, security, and a safe pair of hands when you need professional help.

principles: Built to scale from day one
